nameOfQualification: Programming and Operating Associate (Advanced CNC Machines)
description: This course is designed to develop skills in operations and programing of Advanced CNC 4th and 5th Axis Milling Machines.It provides hands on experience on Basic and Advanced 4th and 5th Axis Milling Machines irrespective of whether the 4th and 5th Axis are on the Machine Head or on Rotary and Tilting Table. It also acquaints them with various aspects such as feed, depth of cut, cutting speed, cutter selection, cutter radius compensation, Tool wear compensations, parametric programming, sister tool concept etc. After successfully completing the course and obtaining requisite certification, the students will become CNC Milling Operator / Programmer and will find job opportunities in manufacturing roles across machine tool manufacturing companies, automotive, defense, aerospace, locomotive, construction, consumer goods, etc. Industries.

leaningUnitGrid.NAME: Comply with workshop health and safety guidelines
Understand and apply basic engineering design, mathematics, measurements, tools, machining, and industrial materials.
Understand manufacturing drawings, GD and T, manufacturing processes, and recognize the importance of quality in manufacturing.
Understand the cutting tool parameters, cutting fluid and machine lubrication.
Generate the NC program using CAM software for CNC turning and milling machine.
Generate the NC program for rotary 4th axis and 5th axis milling Centre by using CAM software.
Create CNC turning machine program and simulation of tool path using CNC simulator.
Prove out CNC part program and inspection of machined components using measuring instruments
Assignments (Based on case studies and Industrial application)
